description: Fetch and extract the full contents of a single URL via Serper Scrape API. Returns the page content as markdown (or plain text). Costs 2 credits per page (every scrape; include_images does not change the price — chains multiply). For synthesized answers prefer search_rag_context or deep_research over scraping many pages.

include_images.description: Include image URLs found on the page. Default: false.

include_links.description: Include links found on the page. Default: false.

include_markdown.description: Return a markdown rendering of the page. Default: true.

include_videos.description: Include videos found on the page. Default: false.

max_chars.description: Truncate returned content to this many characters (1000–200000). Default: 50000.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to scrape (http/https).

name: scrape
